notes.title: Version 1.3 is here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 is available now as a free update to Mask Around! It features new content, quality of life changes and bug fixes. 



Here's the full patch notes:


New Content
Added new weapons

Only Zone 3 featured an exclusive weapon (the Star Shooter), so I decided to give zone 1 & 2 their exclusive weapons as well :

Rigid Riffle (zone 1)

Melon Shooter (zone 2)

Added Sleep Mask and Sleep Backpack

You'll have to be either restless or restful to unlock them...
Improvements
Reworked pause menu to show current items' descriptions

Improved masks, backpacks and items menus UI.

Added particle effect to cursed player

Fixed screenshake causing sudden camera movements

I completely reworked the screenshake system to ensure a smooth experience

Fixed radio button appearing as selected

Fixed incorrect tutorial text languages when using keyboard controls

Other minor fixes

See you around!

notes.title: Version 1.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Mask Around have been updated to version 1.2 on all platforms. Here are the changes: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/f2fed9c7b3ea1cb32ee71b18465b6d44735ed872.jpg
Once you've beat the game with a mask, a star will display next to it and you'll be able to see your best time with this mask.

Additions
 Added run timer logic
     Added a setting to display the run timer (default to off)
 Displayed the run timer on game over screen when successfully completing a run
 Displayed the fastest run timer on the main menu
 Once you complete a run with a mask, it will be granted a "star" in the mask menu
     Changing mask during a run will not star any mask even if you complete the run. 
 Added best time display for each starred mask in the mask menu. 
 Experimental exclusive to the Steam version: time scores are submitted to this leaderboard.
 Added a pacific status indicator after the first floor 


Balance
  Made some room patterns easier for zones 2 and 3
  Punching with "Straigh Up Bleach" while in HAND form will now project juice only if it doesn't hit anything
  Increased BUFF kick hitbox size
  Removed accountability for enemy bomb parrying and dark tree heart killing
  Xray gun's bullets will now project ennemies according to the aiming direction
  Made legger take more time to jump
  Decreased faceless's run speed 


Bug fixes
  Fixed a display bug when the system's language was german or spanish
  Fixed played dying instantly on taking damage while BUFF in fog with only one heart left
  Fixed some objects being not properly destroy when restarting a run
  Fixed player not losing HAND while idle
  Fixed spike balls being stuck in the air
  Fixed spike balls not damaging enemies sometimes
  Fixed some sounds being played too loudly

notes.title: Version V1.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Mask Around is now available on android! I took the time to do some polish, add the requested keyboard rebinding features, and also added a new mask and backpack as a bonus!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/c7c54acdd7b09ab4f783aa0596cd64f7ad7a09f6.gif
Additions
 Added Backpack Mask. beat the final boss with no items and the default gun to unlock! 
 Added Mask backpack. beat the final boss while cursed to unlock! 
 Added keyboard rebind menu in settings
 Added controller dpad support 
Balance
 Increased the damage of the Pink Bubble Mask's bubble from 5 to 15
 Lowered Walker's bulb HP from 30 to 20
 Allowed player to jump out of the detransform animation
 Made third zone a bit easier (I intend on tackling this issue more in future patches):
     Lowered Weird Bird Enemy HP
     Made Legger enemy wait a bit more before jumping
     Tweaked some trap rooms
Bug fixes
 Fixed languages display issues under certains conditions
 Fixed cracked wall not being broken with HAND
 Fixed pacific condition (only enemies directly killed by player's hitboxes or bullets will count as kills)
 Fixed sun mask bullets colliding with player
 Fixed passive juice loss not matching the current juice amount

Please let me know if you encounter any issue with the game. See you around!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest + Release date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/462d3cb7c12e4c5d7f3b59254cc2bbd3dd2c5853.gif
cool gif from the new trailer!!

Hey there, fellow devlog readers! Long time no see. Autumn is kicking in, the days are rainy, and you feel like you need some vivid colors in your life? Well, here's a good news for you: Mask Around will be available on November 8th on Steam!!! Isn't that exciting? I think it is. Yay!

On participating in a virtual festival
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/3f0c6d9464b06a67adb4c39699a78ed8f1e096d7.png
They gave us this template to communicate on the Next Fest so I'm putting it to good use

Can't wait to play? Well, you're in luck: Mask Around is participating in Steam Next Fest starting... today! Try out the freshly updated demo, and take a look at the awesome new trailer for the game, all that from the Steam page. Wishlists, page visits and demo downloads are especially appreciated during this time, because they boost the game's visibility on the platform. I'm currently sitting on ~300 wishlists, which is cool but not a lot at all by indie games standards. So any click helps!

On participating in a real life festival
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/612d113bc70b5266156409fb3f4bf2e86baa753d.png
Me at the Play Sorbonne Festival. Thankfully, I've gotten less socially anxious over the years!

A few weeks ago I was also a participant of the Play Sorbonne Festival, an all-things-gaming student-made festival here in Paris. I had a booth where people could play the game and chat with us. I was surprised to receive so many good feedback from so many different kind of people! Some players even came back later in the day just for a chance to play again. I also had some addicted children that didn't want to let go the controller (which was really weird for me to experience! ... should kids play this  game?).  I received the help of friend and family, and my sister even made a creepy life-sized mask as a decoration. I want to thank again to everyone that helped me or came by for support. This definitely boosted my motivation to clear the last remaining issues and actually release the game!

Putting the last pieces together
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927911/707ddcad8553bf002b9521bc0ce18fb671b4af26.png
One of my first drafts for the supernova-themed final boss! Will you manage to beat it?

Since my last devlog, I've been adding the remaining pieces to Mask Around, namely:
 Made an epic final bossAdded more level patternsAdded the remaining masks and backpacks 
I've finally reached all of my objectives content-wise, with a whopping 24 masks (with unique powers) and 24 backpacks (purely cosmetic) hidden in the game. I'm also quite proud of the final battle, themed around the sun becoming a supernova... I can't wait to see it in the players' hands!

As usual, if you want to help me, you can wishlist Mask Around on Steam, subscribe to my newsletter or follow me on the social media of your choosing! I’ve been sharing a lot of videos lately, showcasing the different items in the game, so this might interest you.

Anyway, thank you for reading, and see you in a few weeks... for release day!

Rouli
